title: Skip-gram with Negative Sampling
signature: def sgns_loss_and_grads(W_in: np.ndarray, W_out: np.ndarray, center: int, context: int, negatives: np.ndarray) -> tuple
hints: Let v = W_in[center]. Compute the positive score s_o = W_out[context] @ v and the negative scores s_k = W_out[negatives] @ v.
-log(sigmoid(x)) = log(1 + exp(-x)) = np.logaddexp(0, -x). It never overflows.
d/dx of -log(sigmoid(x)) is sigmoid(x) - 1, and d/dx of -log(sigmoid(-x)) is sigmoid(x). Chain these through the dot products.
A negative index can repeat, or equal the context. Accumulate output-vector gradients with np.add.at, not fancy-index assignment.
